title: Japan Campervan Snowboard Trip
subtitle: Hokkaido powder belt · Niseko → Yotei → Furano → Asahidake · January 2028
coverCredit: placeholder — swap for Hokkaido powder shot
summary:
**Concept**: fly to Sapporo, pick up a winter campervan, chase snow. No fixed bookings except the van — the weather decides where we ride. Hokkaido's powder belt stretches from the Niseko volcano cluster in the southwest up the central spine to the Daisetsuzan range in the northeast — one logical road trip.

**Crew**: Niko (board), **Jozz (Pieter Willems)** confirmed, **Steven Willems** hopeful — group up to 3–4 fits the 4-pax campervans. **Target: 2nd half of January 2028** (moved from 2027 — Canada took the 2027 slot).

**The draw**: deepest snow in the world (Kiroro ~21 m/season), onsen culture, camper-as-strategy — free overnight spots at resorts and michi-no-eki, splitboard ascent of **Mount Yotei** (1,898 m, "Hokkaido Fuji"), and the **Asahidake** ropeway into Japan's highest snowfields.

**Stage: idea** — route skeleton exists, dates indicative, nothing booked. Hoshino Resorts sells a proven "Hokkaido Powder Belt Campervan Plan" (van + 5-day lift pass Tomamu/Furano/Kamui + breakfast/sauna at Tomamu & OMO7 Asahikawa, from ~¥215,300/van for 4n/5d) that validates the whole weather-chasing approach.

practical.notes:
**Route skeleton (Southwest → Northeast, drive-by-weather)**: Niseko region (incl. Rusutsu, Kiroro, Kokusai) → **Mount Yotei splitboard climb** → Furano (far fewer crowds) → Kamui Ski Links (Asahikawa, "Hokkaido's best-kept secret", part of the Hoshino Powder Belt pass) → Mount Racey (Yubari, breaks up the drive) → **Asahidake** ropeway + backcountry bowls. Small hills on the way: Teine, Bankei, Sapporo Kokusai (night sessions).

**Camper notes**: winter-ready vans have FF diesel heaters + studless tyres (4WD varies — confirm). Free overnight parking at ski-resort lots / michi-no-eki / onsen towns; paid RV parks (~¥2,000–5,500) for power hookup. Jan is Hokkaido's busiest foreign-visitor month — book 3–4 months out. **Belgian licence + JAF translation suffices** (no international driving permit).
